summary: Iteration 3 — validation of the 'camera silent bounce' upload bug fix. Backend (5/5 new pytest cases pass in ~15s total on public URL): (1) large ~4032x3024 JPEG uploads succeed in <30s and returns storage_path + category ∈ {Tops,Bottoms,Outerwear,Shoes,Accessories} + name, and appears in GET /api/items; (2) normal 1280x960 JPEG uploads <15s; (3) empty file body → 400 with detail containing 'empty'; (4) no auth header → 401; (5) GET /api/files/{storage_path}?token=... returns image/* content-type (image/png in practice) with non-empty body for owner. Backend log format 'upload X.XXMB processed in Y.Ys' matches the fix. Frontend (mobile web 390x844, all critical flows PASS): signup with fresh email → Closet with 5 seeded items → tap add-item-fab → Add Item modal → CHOOSE FROM GALLERY (choose-photo-btn) with expect_file_chooser → ANALYSING & REMOVING BACKGROUND overlay (analyzing-overlay) visible → tag-editor appears with prefilled name-field (e.g. 'Minimalist V-neck Top') → save-item-btn → returns to Closet with 6 items visible. Error path: page.route blocked POST /api/items/upload with 500 {detail:'Upload failed'} → inline add-item-error box shows 'Upload failed' text INSIDE the modal, preview stays with retry-upload-btn + reset-photo-btn visible; unblock route → tap retry-upload-btn → tag-editor appears. reset-photo-btn: after error, tapping it returns to TAKE PHOTO / CHOOSE FROM GALLERY buttons and clears the error box (verified error node absent). Regression: item- cards open item detail (delete-item-btn visible), close-detail returns to closet, delete a different item via delete-item-btn → 'Item removed' toast (still working) and grid count decreases from 7 → 6. No deprecated Expo packages detected in this iteration's touched files; no React Native red-screen errors; no console errors other than the intentional 500 route stub. Compression path (expo-image-manipulator) exercised only on native per code; web path uploads the original as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py upload_item runs Gemini tagging on the downscaled 1024px JPEG (small) but background removal (rembg) still on raw full-size bytes — for very large photos rembg is the remaining bottleneck. Consider passing `small` (or a moderately downscaled variant) to remove_background too if further speedups are needed.
compress-image.ts falls back to original uri on any error silently — good UX but consider logging a warning so future regressions are visible.
add-item.tsx catch on line 88-91 swallows exception without logging; useful for debugging camera/library errors.
api.ts uploadItemImage uses `require('react-native').Platform` inline — small nit; import at top instead for consistency.
seed_data_creation: One fresh signup account (e2e.sv+<hex>@example.com / pass1234) auto-seeded with 5 mock wardrobe items. Uploaded 1 real item during success flow → 6 items; regression flow deleted a different mock (soft-delete). Backend test module created a separate 'test.sv+upload<hex>@example.com' account that uploaded 3 more items to exercise the size variants. No cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://stylevault-app.preview.emergentagent.com. New backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_upload_bugfix.py — run alone with: pytest backend/tests/test_upload_bugfix.py -v (works in ~15s). For frontend upload testing on the Expo web preview, expo-image-picker's launchImageLibraryAsync triggers a real hidden <input type=file>, so use Playwright's `page.expect_file_chooser()` context manager wrapped around the click on [data-testid='choose-photo-btn']; then fc.set_files('/path/to.jpg'). Wait up to 60s for [data-testid='tag-editor'] because Gemini tagging + rembg takes 5-15s. To simulate upload failure without changing backend, `await page.route('**/api/items/upload', lambda r: r.fulfill(status=500, content_type='application/json', body='{"detail":"Upload failed"}'))` then unroute for retry. New testIDs verified present in add-item modal: take-photo-btn, choose-photo-btn, analyzing-overlay, add-item-error, upload-retry-row, retry-upload-btn, reset-photo-btn, tag-editor, name-field, save-item-btn, close-add-item. Note that native camera path (TAKE PHOTO) cannot be exercised on web preview per problem statement.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (camera silent bounce back to pickers) is FIXED and behavior verified via error simulation on web: (1) errors are now surfaced inline in the modal via testID='add-item-error' rather than routed to the root ToastProvider that would render UNDER the iOS native modal — verified the error text 'Upload failed' rendered inside the modal DOM. (2) preview no longer resets to picker buttons on failure — verified retry-upload-btn + reset-photo-btn remain visible and preview is preserved; the picker screen only returns when user explicitly taps reset-photo-btn. Backend perf fix (downscale to 1024px + concurrent asyncio.gather of tagging + rembg + Empty image 400 guard) confirmed: 4032x3024 JPEG upload completes well under 30s (measured single-digit seconds in practice thanks to downscale + concurrency). No further action required.
